systemPromptSection: pluglet is the user's task list: a JSON file on disk that the user also reads and writes through the `pluglet` CLI, so what you add or complete is visible to them and what they add is visible to you. Use the pluglet_* tools whenever the user asks to record, review, count or finish their tasks, or asks which pluglet commands their profile offers. There is no tool to edit or delete a task, and a command that pluglet_help reports but these tools do not cover is something the user runs themselves.

tools.name: pluglet_list
tools.description: Return every task in id order, one per line as `<id> [x] <title>` for a done task and `<id> [ ] <title>` for an open one. Empty output means the list has no tasks.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Use the same value on every call in a conversation so all calls address one task file.

tools.name: pluglet_add
tools.description: Append a new open task with the given title; the result states the id assigned to it, the next sequential integer.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Use the same value on every call in a conversation so all calls address one task file.

tools.name: pluglet_done
tools.description: Mark the task with the given id done. Marking a task that is already done succeeds and says so without changing the list; an id that no task has is an error.

id.description: Id of the task to complete, as shown by pluglet_list.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Use the same value on every call in a conversation so all calls address one task file.

tools.name: pluglet_help
tools.description: Return the commands available under the profile, one per line with the command name and its description, including the commands that the profile's plugins add.

profile.description: Path to the pluglet profile file; relative paths resolve from the working directory. Use the same value on every call in a conversation so all calls address one task file.
